headline: Sunday in Branson: Mild Skies & Holiday Lights Glow
lede: Sunday, November 8 brings mild highs near 64°F with mostly sunny skies and light winds — ideal for enjoying the growing holiday lights displays and a relaxed lakeside day.

featured.title: Holiday Lights on the Landing & Strip
featured.why: Holiday lights and decorations are in full glow across the Landing waterfront and the Strip. A festive, low-key evening stroll for first-timers. Confirm current hours locally.
